messages:
maria: heads-up, seeing a ~3x latency tail on pool2 GPU jobs in us-west-2 since ~03:40 UTC, correlating with AER/Xid spikes and intermittent nvlink flaps on a subset of cards
chen: which nodes? any ECC counts rising?
maria: main suspects: pool2-node-07, pool2-node-09, rack10-gpu5
maria: quick grep from dmesg on pool2-node-07:
```
[03:41:12] pcieport 0000:65:00.0: AER: Corrected error received: severity=Corrected, type=Transaction, id=0000(00), masked=0
[03:41:12] nvidia-nvlink nvlink0: nvlink: link status degraded, retrying
[03:41:13] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
```
raj: ugh 79s again. last time that mapped to flaky riser/cable
sara: perf graphs: https://dash.internal/reports/pool2/latency?from=03:30&to=04:00 — spike lines up with nvlink up/down events
oliver: @maria can you paste `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` from one of the nodes?
maria: pasted from pool2-node-07:
```
Attached GPUs: 4
GPU 0:
  Ecc Mode                  : On
  Volatile Uncorr. ECC      : 12
  Volatile Corr. ECC        : 423
```
maria: correction: GPU0 volatile uncorrected jumped to 47 in the last 30m
infra-bot: Incident created: INF-2026-3784 'pool2 intermittent nvlink/pcie corrected errors' (link: https://infra.tix/INF-2026-3784)
chen: can we repro with stress test? try running memtest & link stress on pool2-node-07 in maintenance slot
maria: agree. schedule drain for pool2-node-07 then run tests. not enough headroom to drain both 07 and 09 simultaneously without impacting SLAs
sara: current Dedicated capacity usage for us-west-2 pool2 is at 87% committed. no spare nodes in same pool.
oliver: propose temporary routing policy: route new short jobs to pool1 in us-west-2 and noncritical batch to us-east-1 until we stabilize
raj: +1. also recommend immediate hot-swap of riser on rack10-gpu5 if tests fail
maria: plan: 1) cordon pool2-node-07 2) drain with --ignore-daemonsets 3) run vendor diagnostic + nvlink stress 4) swap riser if failure reproducible 5) escalate to RMA
maria: commands I'll run:
```
kubectl cordon pool2-node-07
kubectl drain pool2-node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
ssh ops@pool2-node-07 sudo /opt/vendor/bin/nvlink_stress --duration 600
ssh ops@pool2-node-07 sudo /opt/vendor/bin/gpumemtest --passes 5
```
chen: add `--force` if pods are blocking, but be careful with stateful workloads
sara: I'll open a capacity flex request to temporarily shift 2 nodes from pool1 to pool2 if drain causes capacity crunch
infra-bot: Autoscaler adjusted pool1 -> pool2 suggestion: suggest scale delta +2 (pending approvals)
oliver: if we end up RMA-ing cards, what's the expected lead time for replacement riser/board? procurement?
raj: we stock spare risers in rack spares RMA shelf, lead time 24-48h for new cards, 3-5d for full board replacement
maria: running diagnostics now, will post results in 20m. tagging @oncall (chen) for follow-up
chen: oncall ack, will keep monitoring and be ready to approve capacity flex
sara: cost note: cross-region failover to us-east will add ~12% infra egress + higher latency for some customers. prefer intra-region pool shuffle first
maria: diag results:
```
nvlink_stress: detected link timeout on link 2 after 120s
gpumemtest: pass 1-3 ok, pass 4 found single-bit soft error corrected, pass 5 uncorrectable error at offset 0x4f2a
```
oliver: that uncorrectable is the tipping point. RMA recommended
raj: agreed. plan RMA for GPU in pool2-node-07, schedule riser swap as immediate hotfix if available
maria: created RMA ticket RMA-4491 and updated INF-2026-3784 with logs
infra-bot: Deploy-bot: rolling drain scheduled for pool2-node-07 at 04:25 UTC (window 04:25-05:10). Notifications sent to affected teams.
maria: after hot-swap/RMA we'll run 12h soak with nvlink stress and rebaseline latency. if stable, we'll uncordon
chen: follow-up: add automated alert rule: incremental Xid count > 10 in 15m for a host -> severity P2 and suggest cordon. filing as ENGOPS-232
sara: capacity flex approved for +2 nodes from pool1 to pool2 for 6h window
maria: summary of action items:
- maria: drain + diagnostics + RMA ticket
- raj: prepare spare riser & be on-call for swap
- chen: monitor & approve force drains
- sara: capacity flex & cost approval
maria: will update INF-2026-3784 once RMA complete or if tests indicate false positive
chen: thx all :thumbsup:
